plan.failureSummary: Cached replay failed to locate the 'Last Name' input field because the survey form rendered a different set of fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside generated cache replay file: tests/.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:38:9
Failure screenshot shows fields 'Your Name', 'Contact Email', and 'Occupation' instead of the cached 'Last Name' and 'Email Address' inputs
The overall instruction 'Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...' is semantically flexible
Browser logs show no console or network errors
usedDeterministicMode is true and isRetryAttempt is false

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and rerun the test suite to let the autonomous agent adapt to the current survey form layout.

additionalDataRequests.description: Verify dynamic form variants of the unstable-survey application to ensure the autonomous agent handles all question variations.

plan.notes: The test targets an unstable survey application where the form layout varies. The failure occurred inside the deterministic cache replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js). Clearing the Page.AI cache and retrying autonomously will allow Page.AI to fill the current form fields.
